task: Improve the Webhook integration setup form with a read-only URL field, alias-to-ID auto-fill, collapsible accordion sections, and a name-based resource dropdown.

key_reasoning.reason: Four independent feature areas (URL display field, alias auto-fill with override flag, data-driven accordion grouping, resource dropdown with Valtio hook) each require changes across SettingsForm, CredentialFields, settingsUIConfig, settingsUI types, and new files — 3 architectural layers touched.

Most requirements are precisely specified, but the GitLab section accordion is explicitly deferred ('or confirm with PO') — an unresolved ambiguity requiring product owner clarification before implementation. Also, buildWebhookURL path correctness (BASE_URL prefix) must be verified against the live environment.

The data-driven accordion grouping mechanism has no established precedent in the codebase: existing accordion usages (FormAccordion, ConfigAccordion) are all explicit, not data-driven. Adding collapsible grouping to the CredentialFields renderer requires a novel architectural decision (accordionGroup container type vs. pre-processing pass) with no prior pattern to copy. The useResourceOptions three-way conditional Valtio fetch is also a new pattern in this domain.

red_flags_applied: Requirements Clarity bumped from M (3) to L (4): GitLab section accordion requirement is explicitly deferred with 'or confirm with PO' — a TBD that requires product owner resolution before implementation begins.
